results.title: Budget Policy Statement
results.description: A citizen-friendly guide to Kenya's Budget Policy Statement 2026, prepared under the guidance of Millicent Makina, Board Advisor at Budget Ndio Story.

steps.title: Understanding the BPS
steps.text: Part 1 — Before Budget Day: This Is Where It Starts. The Budget Policy Statement (BPS) is Kenya's early roadmap for the national budget. It sets priorities, spending ceilings, and policy signals before the full estimates are published.

steps.title: Reading the BPS 2026 Summary
steps.text: Part 2 — Before the Budget: This Is Where It Starts. Go deeper into the BPS and why it matters before Budget Day — where government priorities become clearer and major budget choices begin to take shape.

steps.title: BPS and the BETA Agenda
steps.text: Part 3 — Before Budget Day: This Is Where It Starts. Break down what the BPS is and why young people should care — how choices on jobs, education, healthcare, business, and taxes begin to take shape.
